title: The Witness List
subtitle: A task gated on carrying an item
description: The weddings of harvest week need witnesses, and the village
insists its witnesses arrive fed: the checkmark below carries an
item condition -- two golden carrots, carried -- and a submit
against an unmet condition is refused rather than ignored.
A condition counts and never takes: the carrots are still there
after the press. Conditions gate acquiring progress; they do not
